    Twisting modules by automorphisms #

    For Lemma 4.13 (lem:scalar-object-values): "A weight scales morphism lines and thus defines an automorphism of L. These automorphisms act on the indecomposable module classes with any fixed finite support, by precomposing their actions with the scalar automorphism. […] only finitely many indecomposable classes supported in S occur. Their permutation image is finite, abelian and divisible, hence trivial."

    For an automorphism σ of a representation-finite algebra, the twist M ↦ M^σ permutes the finitely many indecomposable classes, so a fixed power N (the order of the permutation group) of any automorphism fixes every class (twist_pow_iso). With the divisibility of weights this gives the triviality of the action.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
